name: play_media
description: Play named local media. The required media_type must be mp3 for MP3 or audio, mp4 for MP4 or video, or any when the user states no format. Put only the requested media name in title; exclude command and format words.

title.description: The complete requested media name without command or format words.

artist.description: An artist explicitly identified by the user. Omit when uncertain.

media_type.description: Required MP3 versus MP4 decision grounded in the user command.

name: control_playback
description: Control the current track: play, resume, pause, stop, previous track, or next track.

name: show_mp3_files
description: Filter the media list to MP3 audio files without changing panel visibility. Command example: Show MP3 files.

name: rewind_10_seconds
description: Move playback backward by exactly 10 seconds. Command example: Rewind 10 seconds.

name: skip_forward_10_seconds
description: Move playback forward by exactly 10 seconds. Command example: Skip forward 10 seconds.

name: show_original_videos
description: Filter the media list to original MP4 videos without changing panel visibility. Command example: Show original videos.

name: show_karaoke_files_or_videos
description: Filter the media list to karaoke files or videos without changing panel visibility. Command example: Show karaoke files.

name: show_all_media_files
description: Clear the media category filter without changing panel visibility. Command example: Show all media. This is a filter action, not a panel action.

name: search_library
description: Search the media library for a user-provided title or artist query. Command example with a fictional query: Find Example Track Alpha.

name: refresh_library
description: Refresh or rescan the local media library.

name: set_volume
description: Set playback volume to an explicit numeric percentage from 0 to 100. Use only when the user states the value; never invent one.

name: mute_audio
description: Mute or silence playback.

name: unmute_audio
description: Unmute playback or restore sound.

name: load_eq_preset
description: Load a named equalizer preset. Use only when the user explicitly requests an EQ preset. Never add a volume.

name: show_graphic_equalizer_panel
description: Show, open, or display the Graphic Equalizer panel. Use only when the user names the equalizer.

name: close_graphic_equalizer_panel
description: Close or hide the Graphic Equalizer panel.

name: show_library_panel
description: Open or show the Media Library panel without changing its category filter. Command example: Show the library. This is a panel action, not a filter action.

name: hide_media_library_panel
description: Hide or close the Media Library panel when the user explicitly names the library.

name: close_performance_monitor_panel
description: Close or hide the Performance Monitor panel.

name: set_panel
description: Show, hide, open, close, or toggle only the voice command or sidebar panel.
